top_choice_rationale: P003 recognizes a mature and transformative, tightly bounded framework that made firm heterogeneity and endogenous selection central to analysis of trade and its gains. Melitz is indispensable, and Helpman and Redding are defensible complementary credits when the citation remains confined to this specific achievement.
recusal_note: I disclose a documented long-running collaboration with Peter J. Klenow, credited on B031, which is not represented in the proposal slate. No connection to the proposed P003 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile.
